The '''Cantina Hangover''' was a [[Shift-Vertical]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. A simple Fence built in the shape of a large oblong tube, [[swoopchaser]]s raced through a dimly lit recreation of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] with tables, stools, and bar fixtures fixed to the walls. The tube rotated, and the effect threw off the rider's spatial awareness or made them suffer from vertigo.<ref name="BSS" />
